name: iRobot Factory
description:
About This Game

Can your robot solve every level?

Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming in the iRobot Factory! You can create your own robot and teach it to solve tasks - simply by connecting logic blocks together.

Your robot will be completely on its own as it tackles the levels. In order for it to succeed, you have to prepare it!

Build your own robot!

Choose from a variety of building blocks and assemble your robot! Customise it to do what it needs to do in the level! Wheels allow it to move. Sensors allow it to perceive its surroundings. Gripper arms allow it to pick up objects and carry them with it.

 

Programme its abilities!

Link logic blocks to teach your robot what to do! Programme how it reacts to the world around it so that it reaches the level's goal!

Send a signal to the wheels to make them turn. Read the signal from a sensor to extend a gripper arm at the right moment. Link several signals so that your robot can swerve out of the way when it rolls towards a wall. You can programme this and much more for your robot!

 

There are lots of levels to solve

Solve tricky tasks in increasingly challenging levels - from small obstacles to big puzzles where you have to combine all your knowledge! Start by building a robot with working wheels and finish by creating complex machines that master several different tasks.
short_desc: Solve logic puzzles and obstacle courses in this robot simulation game! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming! Create your own robot, connect logic blocks and teach it to solve challenging tasks!
